Default representation changed from concat_center_tfidf to hierarchical_leiden. All 91 tests pass.

known_limitations: Section modes: 63 decisions use section-specific projections, 937 use baseline fallback (blended approach)
Frontend uses HTML5 Canvas only - no WebGL/Mapbox for large-scale rendering
No authentication or rate limiting on API
HDBSCAN produces fewer clusters than Leiden at same zoom levels (2-8 vs 5-21)
TF-IDF model uses truncated text (2000 chars max per document)
Cross-language neighbors limited by language-dominant clustering
Language filter is a simple toggle (no compound language queries)
Cluster coherence is computed on-demand (not cached server-side)
Temporal filtering requires year metadata in corpus (not all decisions have it)
Legal-distance signals not available as map modes (legal-distance lane UNTESTED)
Full TF-2000+ corpus scale pending corpus lane completion (currently 1000-decision slice)
